rules.statement: V used coolant before completing the disconnection that released 8ug8ear safely from her netrunning chair. This establishes the treatment she underwent; it does not give her a conscious recollection of being carried afterward.
rules.review: Personal-link device chain 91→97→92→94→90 writes unplug; waiter74 and cooled>=1 condition86 True reach normal=1. Cooling scene End_cooled writes cooled=1. Scene actor is explicitly 8ug8ear. No inference from generic completion. Details are admitted only after V explicitly shares them because 8ug8ear was unconscious.

rules.statement: After the safe disconnection, V handed the unconscious 8ug8ear to Wakako’s extraction transport. She can acknowledge the rescue but cannot recount the unconscious journey as something she watched.
rules.review: Transport condition87 checks rey_09_target inside rey_09_van; its output succeeds bring_tobias, then the completion delay leads to the main quest Succeeded socket and finished=1. Adds positive safe-disconnection evidence; never uses finished alone as a survival inference. The unconscious journey requires V disclosure before becoming personal knowledge.

rules.statement: V brought Chang Hoon Nam out of his trapped netrunning state for Wakako. After recovering, Nam recognized Wakako’s involvement and offered to show V some netrunning techniques.
rules.review: Scene section158 explicitly exchanges the rescue acknowledgement and invitation (English screenplay items2817–4097) before node128 increments nam_endings. This is recovery, not proof a vendor transaction occurred.

rules.statement: V returned Iris Tanner’s vehicle to Dakota’s garage. This is the recovered-car outcome, separate from merely bringing Iris to safety.
rules.review: Named hostage-community car entering ina_06_tr_stop_car_garage triggers locked interactions, invulnerability and brake, then delivered +=1 and park_car_in_garage Succeeded. Also requires the independent positive rescue completion. Not vehicle destruction, generic quest done or spawn state.

rules.statement: V got Iris Tanner back to Dakota’s operation after the Wraith captivity. The vehicle recovery remains a separate question.
rules.review: Both hired +=1 writers are retained: base completion follows phase/quest Succeeded; optional vehicle-reward branch follows completion reward and token cleanup. The failed/abandoned cleanup has iris_gone/left_alone instead. Narrative statement is bounded to rescue, not employment terms.

rules.statement: V completed the recovery of Jake Estevez’s pickup for him. This does not establish whether V used stealth or fought at the shop.
rules.review: Release cleanup tests the actual Life’s Work journal Succeeded at node24; only True gives completion reward and succeed=1. Bugfix writes the same fact only after a journal Succeeded gate. Generic finished/complete and kill_all are not used. The mq044.quest occurrence is a standalone harness initializer, not the production main-quest route.

rules.statement: Jake sent V an invitation to collect the car he set aside as a thank-you. The invitation itself does not mean V has collected it.
rules.review: Main setup distinguishes positive Life’s Work success: True activates Jake’s vehicle message; False activates Muamar’s alternate vehicle_info message. Requires Jake’s exact revealed SMS path. Never infer gift provenance from car ownership.

rules.statement: V collected the Quadra associated with Jake’s thank-you gift. Jake receives the quest’s corresponding debrief message; this is the Jake route, not simply ownership of an identical vehicle.
rules.review: Vehicle-specific OnMount plus leaving the garage area succeeds leave_area. Positive prior success chooses Jake’s debrief path; completion then sets done=1 and enables the Quadra. Positive success plus Jake’s exact invitation AND debrief receipts prevent retroactively classifying an earlier alternate acquisition as Jake’s gift.

rules.statement: V sent Lizzy the recording exposing Liam’s plan to make an engram of her and discussed the danger behind it. Lizzy has received that evidence; this does not establish that any engram was actually produced.
rules.review: Holocall records the send_data objective and Lizzy’s reaction before the positive recording_sent increment. This is an actual disclosure receipt in the native story, unlike V-only full_story or software evidence.

rules.statement: V reported to Lizzy that Liam appeared to be having an affair. This is V’s claim, not independent confirmation of an actual affair.
rules.review: Choice136 cheating ordinal0 → section159 (English lines2561/2817/3073) → write214. The other option sends evidence. Uses a positive report-specific fact; never infers this branch from recording_sent=0.

rules.statement: Liam paid V after V accepted his offer of money during the Riot confrontation. He can remember that agreement; it does not establish what V later told Lizzy.
rules.review: Section128 contains V accepting the money and Liam confirming transfer, followed by exact bribed=1. Bounded to Liam and V, with no private Lizzy disclosure leaked to him.

rules.statement: V completed the task of disposing of Liam’s body for Lizzy after the motel death.
rules.review: The disposal phase waits for positive mq019_liam_disposed then CutControl18 directs its objective Succeeded. Walking outside instead sends Failed and disposed_failed=1. Rule uses the exact successful objective, not merely agreeing to help, entering room, or generic mq019_done.

rules.statement: Rachel reported that the Joshua braindance production was a success and offered V a bonus. This is her production assessment, not proof of a particular religious experience or every prior choice.
rules.review: Two exact writers: Rachel’s voiced favourable call after scene section279, or the rejected-call fallback activating her hit message after doubting<4. Cleanup checks hit==1 for bonus reward. Do not recreate the outcome from a guessed doubt total; consume actual explicit result.

rules.statement: Rachel blamed V for damaging the Joshua braindance production and reacted angrily. This is her hostile production assessment, not objective evidence about Joshua’s faith.
rules.review: Two exact writers: Rachel’s hostile voiced call after section280, or fallback message on doubting>=4. Cleanup checks this positive result for basic pay. If both hit and shit are ever observed, resolver topic conflict suppresses both.

rules.statement: Blue Moon survived V’s protection job and later sent V a message saying she was safe and thanking V. This records her reported safety at that time, not an unlimited guarantee about her current life.
rules.review: Only the exact positive Blue Moon safety SMS qualifies. mq028_done also covers incorrect-target endings; right_target alone can be written at neutralization before final debrief. The false branch sends Red Menace death messages instead. No missing-zero assumption.

rules.statement: V neutralized the woman who was actually stalking Blue Moon. This does not establish whether she was killed or whether Blue Moon witnessed it. Blue Moon may discuss V’s account after V shares it.
rules.review: Positive right_target is written only after the Herring_Girl killed/defeated/unconscious condition. It does not prove whether she was killed, whether Blue Moon survived, or whether the name Griselda was learned. A V disclosure receipt is required, because this flag does not establish Blue Moon witnessed the neutralization.

rules.reason: The unsafe-route death marker can also be written for other harm. The exported graph proves the safe branch, but an ordered positive unsafe-disconnect path and unambiguous failed outcome still need review. Generic death or missing cooling values are insufficient.
Recovery dialogue is verified, but later quickhack-vendor availability and an observed vendor transaction are separate states. No reviewed vendor-state selector has been authored.

The Phantom Liberty recruitment, completed MaxTac intrusion and resulting aphasia require the exact q305 conversation and follow-up disclosures. Earlier rescue and a netrunner contact do not prove this later employment or injury.

The positive car-delivery branch is reviewed. Absence of that marker cannot establish the optional vehicle was left behind; a successful rescue plus positive omitted-vehicle branch still requires a separate reviewed predicate.
Shop hostility/kill cleanup does not prove V chose an attack or who witnessed it. The participant-specific combat/recognition scene and disclosure boundary have not been fully reviewed.

The alternate Muamar message route is visible in the graph, but a zero prior-success read is not admissible proof. Need its exact positively revealed message and acquisition outcome, with a disclosure receipt before Jake knows V used that route.

The Kerry/Us Cracks confrontation belongs to the sq017 relationship arc. The two band resolutions are authored from narrative evidence but their exact decision scenes have not been verified in this lane.
